sources.traffic_calming: Defaults of a traffic_calming=* node without traffic_calming:length. All [assumed], typical German values: hump (Aufpflasterung) 3.7 m x 70 mm, table (Plateauaufpflasterung) 6 m x 80 mm, cushion (Berliner Kissen) 1.8 m x 70 mm, bump (Schwelle) 0.9 m x 70 mm, mini_bumps 2 m x 30 mm, rumble_strip 1 m x 10 mm, dip 4 m x 60 mm deep. height_mm 0 means render only (chicane, choker, island have no height); width_mm 0 means across the full carriageway. The carved shape is widened to the 1 m grid by the minimum ramp (kFeatureMinRampMm), see road_geom_tile.h.
sources.other_tapers_and_shift_rates: [assumed] rule of thumb 1:20 urban, 1:40 rural, 1:60 motorway lateral rate
sources.junction: Junction geometry parameters of street fidelity P2 (docs/street_fidelity/p2_junction_design.md sections 3 and 8.1). The design draft wrote the sub-metre values in metres with decimals; this loader is integer-only like every other rules block, so those are millimetres here. trim_min 1 m, trim_margin 0.5 m, edge_station_spacing 0.5 m (chord sagitta 3.1 mm at the 10 m minimum radius), bowtie_step 1 m, link_trim_cap 30 m, cluster caps 48 m / 12 nodes and reach 128 m are [assumed] project defaults. The loader enforces the tile-invariance proof: cluster_max_extent + 2 * link_trim_cap <= reach_max, and reach_max + 15 (carve blend) + cluster_max_extent <= 192 (carver radius). Corner fillets (kerb returns): a block corner between two approaches is rounded with the radius of the LOWER of the two classes on the road bed edge, the paved and outer edges follow concentrically (radius minus their offset). Radii after the German urban guideline's corner roundings (RASt 06 6.3.8, unverified): 6 m for residential and unclassified streets (refuse truck), 8 m tertiary, 10 m secondary, 12 m primary/trunk and links (articulated truck), 4 m living streets, service roads and tracks; motorway mainline corners stay sharp (0). corner_min_wedge_deg 20 (gores stay sharp), the tangent length is capped at 150 percent of the radius (the radius shrinks in wedges under 67 degrees, so stop lines stay near the node), and two one-way approaches meeting at a wedge under 60 degrees (a carriageway split) take a 1 m nose radius instead: [assumed].
sources.furniture: Junction furniture of street fidelity P2 (design sections 7 and 8.1), lengths in integer millimetres. Crossing length along the road (the node width tag wins): zebra 4 m [R-FGUe, unverified], signalised 4 m and other 3 m [assumed]. Stop and give-way lines 0.50 m wide [RMS, unverified], signal stop line 0.50 m [assumed]. Setbacks (1 m before a crossing, 1 m at a junction trim, 0.5 m for a sign line), association distances (60 m signal, 40 m sign), the signal post offset (0.5 m outside the carriageway) and the lane count for a second post (3) are [assumed]. crossing_markings maps a crossing:markings value to a pattern, crossing_kind a crossing=* value ([RMS, unverified]: German signalised crossings are Furt dashes, marked and uncontrolled ones zebra stripes). The value yes of crossing:markings is not a key: it falls through to crossing_kind.
sources.tunnel: Owner ruling 2026-10-15 (racing_game PR #5): long tunnels follow straight lines. A tunnel stretch (OSM tunnel=*) at least straight_grade_min_length_m long takes one constant grade between its two portal heights (the DEM at the stretch ends) when that grade is at most the tunnel grade bound (30 %), else the DEM floor; shorter tunnels and underpasses follow the DEM along their reference as before. 200 m is [assumed]: above it the DEM over a tunnel is a hill or mountain, not the floor (cut-and-cover underpasses and short galleries under one road or a railway are well below it, and the deep-tunnel examples of the terrain migration plan are 300 to 540 m); 0 = never. Owner report 2026-10-19 (decision D65): a tunnel stretch shorter than straight_grade_min_length_m and at most cut_max_length_m (80 m) long whose DEM rises between cut_hump_min_mm (1 m) and cut_hump_max_mm (8 m) above the straight chord of its two portal heights is an open cut or gallery through an embankment (a road under a railway on a bank, tagged tunnel in OSM): its floor is that chord, not the DEM over the bank, and the terrain carve cuts the bank along it. All three values are [assumed]; cut_max_length_m 0 = never.
sources.underpass: Owner decision 2026-10-15 (racing_game PR #5): a ground road over a lower road (lower OSM layer or tunnel, no bridge tag) in a DEM cutting keeps its rim height, and only the span over the cutting becomes a deck (design D53-D58). The DEM along the upper road is read +-window_m (50 m) around the crossing; its upper hull, tolerant of a sag of sag_radius_m (300 m), gives the two rims; the depression at the crossing must be at least min_depth_mm (1 m) under the rim chord. The deck covers the lower road (its half width + lower_margin_mm 1 m, along the crossing angle) and the depression deeper than depth_tol_mm (0.1 m), plus abutment_mm (2 m) on each side, inside the rims; at most max_span_m (80 m) long and end_clearance_mm (1 m) from both stretch ends, else declined. All values are [assumed] project defaults; enabled false switches the mask and the decks off.
sources.reference: Vault G2M-024: the reference line (roads.geom clothoid chain) may leave the chord of each OSM node pair by at most chord_half_width_percent (100 = 1.0) times the way's half width plus chord_margin_mm (3 m); beyond that the stretch takes the rounded straight/arc fallback inside the class corridor. The clothoid of a node pair takes its end headings from the neighbouring ways, so a 215 m two-node track beside a trunk road bowed 15 m across it (home-region census: 10 % of all stretches deviated more than 3 m from their OSM polyline, 2.9 % more than 10 m, max 32 m = the old 32 m bow limit; with this bound 3.3 % stay above 3 m (wide roads, inside half width + 3 m) and 5 above 10 m, all among the 10 stretches that keep their old fit because the rounded fallback is infeasible there, max 16.9 m; motorway and trunk lines unchanged). Half width: a road must not leave its own footprint. 3 m margin: [assumed] the corridor fit_stretch already grants local roads (3.0 m; major roads get 0.5 m inside the fitted corridor), about the placement accuracy of an OSM node; 2 m moves 13690 stretches (11039 with 3 m) and one motorway_link by 5 m, 4 m leaves 7 % of the bows. 0 and 0 switch the bound off.
sources.min_edge_radius: Tapers are validated so that the lateral S-ramp (max curvature 4 W / a^2 for a lane width W over a taper of length a) stays at or below 1 / min_edge_radius_m. The radii are [assumed]: 200 m motorway, 60 m other arterial classes, 10 m local classes; the design draft's single default of 60 m contradicted its own urban taper lengths.
